summary: The proposed patch addresses the issue of pylint crashing when running in a Kubernetes Pod with --jobs=0 by ensuring the available CPU count is never zero.

issues.description: The patch does not address the root cause of why the CPU count is being calculated as zero in Kubernetes environments. It only adds a workaround without understanding the underlying issue.
The patch introduces a comment that is not aligned with the project's style guide, specifically the use of '//' for comments instead of '#'.
